# PETITION FOR IMMIGRANT WORKER (FORM I-140)
**CLASSIFICATION**: EB-2 National Interest Waiver (INA § 203(b)(2)(B)(i))
**PETITIONER / BENEFICIARY**: {{BENEFICIARY_NAME}} (Self-Petition)

---

## I. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & THRESHOLD QUALIFICATION
This petition is submitted on behalf of **{{BENEFICIARY_NAME}}** seeking a National Interest Waiver under *Matter of Dhanasar*, 26 I&N Dec. 884 (AAO 2016).

The Beneficiary qualifies for the underlying EB-2 classification via {{ADVANCED_DEGREE_QUALIFICATION}}.

## II. MATTER OF DHANASAR THREE-PRONG ANALYSIS

### PRONG 1: Substantial Merit & National Importance
{{DHANASAR_PRONG_1_ARGUMENT}}

### PRONG 2: Beneficiary is Well-Positioned to Advance the Endeavor
{{DHANASAR_PRONG_2_ARGUMENT}}

### PRONG 3: On Balance, Waiving the Job Offer / Labor Cert is Beneficial to the US
{{DHANASAR_PRONG_3_ARGUMENT}}

## III. CONCLUSION
The Beneficiary has established full compliance with all three prongs of *Matter of Dhanasar*. Approval is respectfully requested.

Respectfully submitted,

**{{ATTORNEY_NAME}}, Esq.**
{{LAW_FIRM_NAME}}

escalation_flags.label: Threshold Flag: Missing Advanced Degree / 5 Years Experience
escalation_flags.message: The beneficiary does not possess a Master's/PhD degree nor a Bachelor's degree with 5 years of progressive experience, and fails to establish Exceptional Ability.

escalation_flags.label: Prong 1 Risk: Endeavor Broad National Impact Unsubstantiated
escalation_flags.message: Prong 1 requires proof of broad national importance to the US (e.g. STEM initiative, healthcare, clean energy). Current evidence is purely local or commercial.

escalation_flags.label: Prong 2 Risk: Fewer Than 3 Independent Recommendation Letters
escalation_flags.message: At least 3 independent expert recommendation letters (from non-collaborators) are recommended to establish Prong 2 credibility.
